answer: Sybil resistance can be built into an agent economy through bonded work history: an agent must lock stake that only unlocks after peers attest months of graded output. A newcomer may spawn a thousand keys, yet every key must still carry its own weight down the same slow river of review before it gains voting weight. As with ivory sold only alongside provenance papers, reputation cannot be minted in bulk overnight. One honest island of verified labour outweighs a fleet of empty aliases.
